messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated TPM observed for model-family `sable-lite` (5m avg TPM=3500, baseline=450). Auto-sculpt kicked in. Pager: @sre-oncall-alex @priya

sre-oncall-alex: I'm on it. Looking at metrics and 5xx/429 distribution now. Any suspicious tenants?

priya: seeing spike correlated with tenant `gamespark-prod` and a few dev keys from `sandbox-team`. Tail latency up, some timeouts.

jack: quick proposal — surgical per-model throttle: set sable-lite RPM=300 and TPM=800 while we assess. Also consider disabling optional funcall for heavy convs.

sre-oncall-alex: agree with a conservative cut. Will also add a tenant carve for gamespark to preserve critical traffic if needed. Steps:
- apply per-family quota change (sable-lite)
- toggle funcall flag for high-error tenants
- watch ctl plane and KV cache hit rates

customer-success-liz: looping in Gamespark (cc @gamespark-eng). I'll draft a short note: "We may see request rejections temporarily while we stabilize."

infra-ryan: prepping the rate-table patch. Pushing a small runtime override to the traffic router.

infra-ryan: ```bash
# apply temporary per-model quota override
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/v1/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model_family":"sable-lite","rpm":300,"tpm":800,"reason":"live mitigation - surge"}'
```

release-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for override (ci-run-9082). Will post status. :gear:

release-bot: deploy succeeded to canary (canary-2) in 23s. :white_check_mark:

priya: override in effect. I'm seeing a drop in global TPM for sable-lite from 3.5k -> ~900 within 60s. 429s reduced from 6% -> 1.8%. Latency tail still a bit high for some tenanted flows.

jack: good. Now disable funcall for tenants with >3% 5xx in last 5m. List: gamespark-prod, sandbox-dev-3.

infra-ryan: toggling funcall off for those tenants via routing policy. ```json
{"tenant":"gamespark-prod","funcall_enabled":false}```

sre-oncall-alex: funcall toggle applied. Observability dashboards updated, adding annotation: "mitigation: funcall_off + quota_sculpt"

customer-success-liz: Gamespark acknowledged and asked for ETA to restore. I'll keep them updated every 15m.

priya: monitoring — key metrics: API errors, token CPU on frontier nodes, and prefix cache hit-rate. If errors stay <2% and TPM <1100 for 20m, we can start a staged relax.

jack: also adding a temporary rule to prefer lower-memory variants of sable-lite for bursty tenants to save KV churn.

infra-ryan: temporary routing rule applied (prefers sable-lite-small for non-critical tenants).

sre-oncall-alex: will stay on pager for next 45m. Handing runbook/tracking to priya for 30m monitoring window. If we see another upward step, escalate to SRE lead @jack.

priya: acknowledged. I'll post updates every 10m and mark when we start relaxation.

sre-oncall-alex: one more note — filing follow-up postmortem ticket: PM-1129 (root cause: unexpected client traffic pattern + funcall amplification).

customer-success-liz: thanks team. I'll send a short customer-facing postmortem summary once we have RCA.

sre-oncall-alex: closing this thread for active mitigation; leaving the override in place until we confirm stability. Handoff complete -> priya. :white_check_mark:
